analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop.swift base units 1-1207 and the complete patch. Head changes add only stored state (head 724-735): selectedModelRecovery (SelectedModelRecovery, defined in ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery, not supplied), selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride (a test seam that is nil in production), savedEnabledModels and enabledModelsAtLastSwitch. Init assigns savedEnabledModels from config.config.backend.enabledModels (head 897).

The added state does not touch keys (A-003 keyPair generation unchanged at base 924), the attestation signer or builder, modelHashes/liveModelHashes (T-012/T-027), App Attest worker state (TB-011/T-053), add-on hold state (TB-012/T-059), or the prefix cache (T-041). Because this file only declares state, no regression is visible here.

Integration must verify the unsupplied ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery:
(1) Recovery loads honor advertised-set, eligibility and weight-hash/self-test gates, including the failedSelfTestHashes and retiringModels tombstones at base 422-430, so a retired or failed build is not reloaded.
(2) Recovery loads respect the add-on hold model-load fence (T-059), drain, update and shutdown admission (updatePhase, isShuttingDown, servingDrain), and the memory-reserve gates.
(3) The no-eviction load cannot bypass the isLoadingAny/reslice serialization.
(4) savedEnabledModels read from the operator-writable config is only status/display data and does not change the running selection outside start or a committed switch, as the comment claims.
(5) The test override cannot be set in production builds.
